728-3249-6723-7316--52.description:

Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Rat King triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

When Azorius Chancery enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability
Repeat.

4682-7132-7824.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger more than once.
4682-7132-7824.description:
Activate Super-Skrull's fourth ability by paying {5}{U}, causing an opponent to draw four cards.
Smothering Tithe triggers four times, causing you to create two Treasure tokens for each time the opponent cannot pay for the trigger.
Activate six Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{U}.
Repeat.
4682-7132-7824.notes:
If the opponent can pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger more times, you can still perform the combo if you have enough mana to outlast their mana supply. You can also continue this combo for other opponents if mana allows.
The extra mana can be used to activate any of Super-Skrull's abilities.

When the Soldier enters, Liliana the Faultless triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Liliana the Faultless trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Liliana the Faultless trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
489-4399-4518-7818.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

The Legend of Kuruk's first and second chapter abilities trigger, causing you to scry 2, draw a card, scry 2 and draw another card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting two lore counters on it. Its third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

Put the tapped Marina into your graveyard due to the legend rule.

Activate Vat of Rebirth by paying {2}{B}, tapping it, and removing four oil counters from it, returning Vishgraz from your graveyard to the battlefield.

Dross Scorpion and Vat of Rebirth trigger.
Resolve Dross Scorpion's trigger, untapping Vat of Rebirth or another artifact.
Resolve Vat of Rebirth's trigger, putting an oil counter on it.
Repeat steps 3 through 6 one additional time.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Vishgraz.
Vat of Rebirth triggers, causing you to put an oil counter on it.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite creature tokens, you may activate Phyrexian Altar any number of times, adding any amount of colored mana.

Gravecrawler dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer and Pawn of Ulamog.

The Eldrazi Spawn dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer, creating a Treasure token.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}{B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Treasure tokens, you may activate Ruthless Knave's last ability any number of times.

Dread and Verdant Succession trigger.

Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for Dread, putting it onto the battlefield and shuffling your library.
